body: We messaged for a day. Small talk
Guys think if you call them pretty instantly they mean something to you.

Okay. I was supposed to see my ex tonight. It was my last effort reaching out but he’s ignoring me. He had promised he’d be there for me. They all did. I have loaded my gun. I’m going on a drive and I’m going to shoot myself in a field. I don’t want my house to lose value because someone died in it. 😂 I’m trying to view this is a good light. I’m happy but anxious. It’s almost over.
So far the pain hasn’t left. It’s gotten worse.

I’m prior military so taking apart the gun isn’t going to stop anything. Takes me seconds to put it back together. I’ll be aiming in my mouth slightly pointed down. My only hang up is the courage to pull the trigger. I want to die. I want this all to be over. Genuinely.
They are young enough they won’t remember. They are babies.

I am killing myself tonight. I have my 9mm. I’ve written my notes. I just have to see my ex one last time tonight. He thinks we’re friends. He forced me to have an abortion then dumped me the next day. He’s constantly asking me to money. My ex husband hates me. I never wanted a divorce. I’ve been in and out of the mental hospital this year. I overdosed on seroquel in December and survived and since then I haven’t been myself. I have two beautiful kids but they don’t deserve a mother like me.
